verdict.rationale: Mem0 doesn't document an explicit region-selection feature for its hosted Platform, but the self-hosted Open Source option (docs-4, docs-21, docs-22) lets a user run Mem0 'on your own infrastructure' with full data ownership, which indirectly satisfies data residency by choosing your own deployment location. missing for 10: explicit multi-region hosting options on the managed Platform, documented data-residency/compliance controls, and any evidence of region-specific storage selection rather than full self-host as the only residency lever.
